name: drift_null_simulation
notes: Bootstrap of one real week (500 articles) used as the null for 500 simulated weeks, each judged against 4 simulated prior weeks. Real week-to-week variation is larger than a bootstrap of one week, so the false-alarm rates are a lower bound. Planted shifts: 10% and 20% of articles relabeled into 'Canada & Montreal' (the 10% case sits right at the 10% effect floor, so low power there is expected). Thresholds from config.py: p<0.01, KS D>=0.15, share shift>=0.1, rate shift>=0.1.
